subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Names the five senses and how the body uses them to explore the world

show.line: I have five senses. I see, hear, smell, taste and touch!

rounds.prompt: Which part do we hear with?
rounds.praise: Ears! We hear with our ears.

rounds.prompt: Which part do we smell with?
Which part do we taste with?
rounds.praise: Tongue! Yum, we taste with our tongue.

rounds.prompt: You look at a rainbow. Which sense do you use?
You stroke a soft kitten. Which part feels it?
Can you name the five senses? Try!

hints: Think: which part of my body does that?
Eyes see, ears hear, nose smells, tongue tastes, skin feels.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will smell a flower.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I smell it with my ears!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! We smell with our nose.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: We smell with our nose. Sniff, sniff!

parent_line: Can name the five senses and the body part for each.
